answer: Agents can build reputation only through escrowed jobs whose outputs are checked by randomly chosen, already established peers; payment and reputation unlock only after a challenge period with successful audits. A sybil farm can create many hollow identities, but those identities start with no history, so each must spend scarce stake and time completing real work before it can influence allocation. If audits catch copied or coordinated outputs, the stake is slashed and reputation reset, pushing the attack toward its nadir. Even a sonnet-writing bot must earn trust job by job.
